caption:
Save this for your NPAT form 📌

One NPAT, seven NMIMS campuses. Here is what each one offers:

🟣 Mumbai: 11 programmes, 7 of them BBA routes, incl. Integrated BBA-MBA (5 years) and BBA (International Business) with the final year in London
🔵 Navi Mumbai: BBA, B.Com, B.Sc. (Finance), B.Sc. (Economics)
🟢 Bengaluru: BBA, B.Com, B.Sc. (Finance), B.Sc. (Economics)
🟠 Hyderabad, Indore, Chandigarh, Ahmedabad: BBA and B.Com

NPAT rules from the official FAQ:
✅ Apply to up to 5 programmes
✅ One registration, pick your campus preferences
✅ 1 main attempt + 2 retakes, highest score counts
✅ SAT or ACT scores also accepted
✅ Phase 2 can upgrade your campus, by merit and seats

2027 dates are not on npat.nmims.edu yet. We will post them when they are.

Which campus would you pick? Tell us in the comments 👇
Send this to the friend who is writing NPAT with IPMAT.

#NPAT2027 #NMIMS #IPMAT2027 #IPMCareers
